config.prevent-downgrades.name: Prevent Downgrades
config.prevent-downgrades.tooltip: Guarantees that re-rolling at the Anvil will never lower your trinket's current tier or stats.
config.pity-system.name: Enable Pity System
config.pity-system.tooltip: Guarantees a tier upgrade after a set number of reforge rolls.
config.pity-rolls.name: Pity Threshold
config.pity-rolls.tooltip: Number of rolls required on a single trinket to guarantee an upgraded tier.
config.iridium-cost.name: Iridium Bar Cost
config.iridium-cost.tooltip: Number of Iridium Bars consumed per reforge at the Anvil (Vanilla = 3).
config.show-tooltips.name: Show Stat Tooltips
config.show-tooltips.tooltip: Displays roll tier stars, bounds, and reforge counts in trinket tooltips.
config.show-messages.name: Show HUD Notifications
config.show-messages.tooltip: Displays a notification banner upon rolling an upgrade or perfect tier.
message.need-iridium: You need at least {{count}} Iridium Bars to reforge this trinket.
message.need-prismatic: You need 1 Prismatic Shard to ascend this trinket.
message.already-ascended: This trinket has already undergone Prismatic Ascension.
hud.reforge-perfect: ✦ Perfect Reforge! Your {{item}} reached maximum stats! ✦
hud.ascension-success: 🌈 Prismatic Ascension Complete! Unlocked {{skill}} on your {{item}}! 🌈
ascension.frogegg.name: Full Harvest Feast
ascension.frogegg.desc: Swallowing monsters drops all of their normal loot and rewards.
ascension.fairybox.name: Sanctuary Bloom
ascension.fairybox.desc: Fairy heal pulses also restore health to nearby allies, farmhands, horses, and pets.
ascension.parrotegg.name: Treasure Hunter
ascension.parrotegg.desc: Doubles the amount and drop frequency of gold coins from defeated monsters.
ascension.goldenspur.name: Battle Frenzy
ascension.goldenspur.desc: Critical strike speed buff also grants +Attack damage.
ascension.magicquiver.name: Spectral Piercer
ascension.magicquiver.desc: Spectral arrows pierce through all enemies in their path.
ascension.icerod.name: Shatter Strike
ascension.icerod.desc: Striking frozen enemies shatters the ice for bonus critical damage.
ascension.basiliskpaw.name: Gorgon's Retribution
ascension.basiliskpaw.desc: Reflects a portion of incoming damage directly back to attackers.
